sixDecimalScore.description: ADR-0013 option C: a signed six-decimal-exact string in [-1, 1], ties-to-even, negative zero forbidden by construction. Verifiable by a generic JSON Schema validator without executing the scoring engine.

microScore.description: ADR-0013 option C: the same value as its six-decimal-string twin, as a signed integer of millionths, in [-1000000, 1000000].

omissionReason.description: ADR-0015 Q2-A closed taxonomy for a statement that contributes zero weight to the score. explicit-skip: the person explicitly skipped this statement, or recorded no response for it (the engine treats both identically, SEMANTICS.md § response handling). abstention: every considered vote for this statement was an abstention under the method's abstentionTreatment, leaving nothing to weight. vote-data-unavailable: the dataset carries no usable vote split for this statement/method pairing. representative-absent: the representative(s) this statement is scored against were absent from the scrutin.

weightedNumerator.description: ADR-0014 option B: the exact integer numerator of the score, sum(r_i * (for_i - against_i)) over every considered statement. score == round(weightedNumerator / scaledDenominator, 6 decimals, ties-to-even) is a machine-checkable invariant of this document alone.

scaledDenominator.description: ADR-0014 option B: the exact integer denominator of the score, M * denominator (M is the method's maximum absolute response-scale value).

omissions.description: ADR-0015 Q2-A: replaces the v2 scalar 'omitted' vote count. One entry per statement that contributes zero weight to the score, naming why.

weightedTerm.description: ADR-0014 option B: this statement's exact integer term r_i * (for_i - against_i). sum(weightedTerm) across contributions equals weightedNumerator, a machine-checkable invariant of this document alone.
